name: Baby Stache
hook: Skip kindergarten and speedrun an entire midlife crisis from the crib
tagline: A newborn swaddled in nursery fleece rapidly grows an oil-slick handlebar mustache while filling out IRS 1040 tax forms as the multiplier spikes. Cashing out lets him retire early to a golf condo in Florida with his 401k safely rolled over. Crashing triggers a massive colic tantrum that blows his monocle and suspenders clear off.
